TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER 11/21/2062 09:42 Caller: Marisol Tangen (pt), call back (417) 555-0172. Taken by: Hartley Bonsu RN Regarding: coff for a week, brown stuff, wheezy.

Past medical: obesity and prediabetes (A1c 6.2 on 11/17). Gingivitis. Patient did not want a message left at home because husband Bert answers the house line and "does not need to know". Okay to talk to daughter Calla Tangen-Moyer at 417-555-0185. Pt asked us not to mention anything to neighbor Mrs. Ngata who works at the pharmacy.
Advice per protocol: fluids, rest, sees provider Friday 11/24 at 10:30 for sputum test and exam. Goes to urgent care if worse. Call back if she gets a temp over 101.
Copied from last note: Patient is a 56 y/o woman, stress, GAD-7 20, medications reconciled 11/10, last seen by Dr. Sorrento. GAD-7 score is 4 not 20.
Dr. Aldermarsh said ok to book. Message to: Dr. Aldermarsh, cc Dalia Whitcombe, email d.whitcombe@cedarhollow.example. Documented by hbonsu 11/21/2062 09:58.
